definitions.macroMAE: Equal mean of four within-window MAEs, not a pooled mean
definitions.contribution: Sum of subgroup error gains / all accepted pairs of that season, then equal mean of four seasons; additive
definitions.pooledScores: Conditional mean over subgroup pairs pooled across seasons; different denominator from macro contribution
definitions.macroRMSE: Equal mean of four seasonal RMSEs; does not decompose additively
definitions.mseContribution: Uses squared errors; additive MSE, not RMSE
definitions.futureLabels: Outcomes and change magnitudes need the target; explanatory only, never available forecast gates
definitions.amplitudeCut: 0.05 mg/L is an inspected post-hoc descriptive cut; not selected, optimized or validated for prediction
definitions.attenuationProof: F(lambda)=mean_seasons mean_rows |actual-current-lambda*d| is convex. A positive right derivative at zero implies F(lambda)>F(0) for any constant lambda>0 on this finite dataset only

limitations: Four already-inspected 28-day 2025 windows at one tidal station; seasonal labels are not full-season validation
Archived finalized observations do not establish as-of-origin availability, instrument accuracy or live forecasting skill
Equality and 0.1 mg/L increments concern published values, not physical constancy or measurement uncertainty
Examples are deterministic extremes, not typical performance; coefficient contributions are arithmetic, not causal effects
No attribution to weather, tides, pollution or human activity is established by this decomposition
No observed target below illustrative 5 mg/L; no hypoxia alert, intervention or ecological benefit validated
No calibrated prediction intervals or independent subgroup uncertainty estimates; grouped results are descriptive
mission: Verifiable environmental predictions in support of community and youth decision rights; no change to operational Oracle, governance, quorum, treasury, token or spending
